note: Campground and marina (formerly Jolly Rogers) on a point of Coralville Reservoir north of North Liberty, with leased boat slips and storage, a boat ramp, courtesy docks, a camp store and Bobbers Grill (full bar, live music on weekends). Many full-hookup sites, including the shoreline rows, are seasonal. --Claude
summary: Rates confirmed ($38 water+electric / $40 full hookup, plus 6% tax; 2026 page). Confirmed 2-night and holiday 5-night minimums; added 50-amp, 91 sites, showers, camp store, phone booking, check-in/out; season mid-April opening confirmed. Lakefront kept with a lead: the shoreline rows are mostly seasonal sites. Pin is at the entrance, 250 m off.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (lakefront kept, may go down): on the operator's site map (2014 image, still on its Maps page) the shoreline rows - N1-N13 along the north shore and E19-E37 along the east shore facing the leased houseboat and pontoon slips - are blue 'SEASONAL FULL HOOK UP SITES'. NAIP shows those rows ~10-40 m from a rip-rapped shore across open grass with no road in front (the loop roads run behind them); the east row has marina gangways to the leased slips crossing the strip. The nightly sites (yellow full hookup / red water-electric) are mostly inland behind roads and parking. Two yellow full-hookup sites at the SE corner (E38-E39, ~41.8016,-91.5884) look ~15 m from the shore on imagery. If seasonal-only sites don't count for a nightly visitor, this goes to lakeview unless E38/E39 hold it.

PRIVATE GATE: $38 + 6% tax = $40.28 (water+electric), $42.40 full hookup; 2026 page. One RV Life camper reported $53 (10/2025, 'Advertised full hookup but no sewer connection'). No gateway (nearest family home 224 km). Under $50 on the posted rate. Google 4.5/48; RV Life 4 stars (listed as 'Scales Campground and Marina', $$, avg $36).
PRESENCE: operator website (© 2026) with phone (319) 665-3474; Google open, 48 reviews, same phone. Passes.

LONG-STAY: test 2 passes (daily $38/$40 posted). Seasonal contracts and monthly rates are sold, and on the site map roughly half of the numbered sites are blue seasonal; an RV Life review (6/2023): 'all the sites with FHU are for the people who stay or rent the whole summer spots year after year'. Daily water/electric sites are sold to transients (RV Life 'Quick Overnight' 10/2024, 'overnight stay' 10/2025). Test 4 (1 in 10 nightly) passes comfortably; not mostly seasonal in my reading, Google 4.5 so the auto-drop rule doesn't arise.
PIN: stored 41.80149,-91.59176 is on the entrance road by the boat-storage lot; the campground's site centre is ~41.8032,-91.5896 (~250 m NE). Proposing 41.8032,-91.5896.
